<!-- Which observable behavior or operating rhythm should this change support? -->

## Rollback plan
<!-- Explain how to reverse the change without losing private evidence. -->

## Governance checklist
- [ ] Weekly workload remains at or below 3–4 independent hours.
- [ ] Every new weekly plan has no more than three major outcomes.
- [ ] Every behavioral task has observable evidence and a review question.
- [ ] No private messages, names, medical details, company secrets or conflict transcripts are included.
- [ ] Spouse, child, colleagues and contacts are not scored or profiled.
- [ ] This PR remains unmerged until Mohsen explicitly approves it.
